remarks: **HIGHEST & BEST BY MONDAY, 1/6 at 5:00PM** Welcome to 2539 Bedford Street, Unit 37D, an exquisite, gated townhouse nestled in the prestigious Chesterfield complex. This elegant and modern residence is one of the largest units available, an expansive 2,636 square feet of luxurious living space.  Upon entering, you are greeted by a bright and airy ambiance that flows seamlessly throughout the home. The main level boasts a sophisticated living room and dining area, perfect for entertaining or enjoying a cozy evening by the fireplace. The brand-new stainless steel appliances in the kitchen add a touch of modern elegance, while large windows and sliders invite an abundance of natural light, creating a harmonious connection with the outdoors. The upper levels feature (2) generously sized bedrooms, each with its own en- suite bathroom. The Primary Suite is a true sanctuary, complete with soaring vaulted ceilings and a spacious full bathroom. An additional loft space is a serene spot for reading or relaxation. The lower level provides versatile space for an office or playroom, along with convenient laundry and garage access.  This home is designed for comfort and convenience. Enjoy the luxury of a private balcony with serene views, perfect for unwinding after a long day. The Chesterfield complex has a wealth of amenities, including a clubhouse, (2) in-ground pools, pet-friendly policies, and security.
